models.title: Defensive interval from period cash expenditures
models.summary: The defensive interval divides quick assets by average daily cash expenditures; daily expense is total period expense divided by its duration.

relationship.original_equation: Defensive interval = (cash + short-term marketable investments + receivables) / daily cash expenditures
relationship.translation_notes: This is the source ratio with daily expenditures replaced by period cash expenditures divided by physical period duration; output uses days.
